request.prompt: Create exactly one isolated full-body Rampart Mech from the Omega DLC of Mass Effect 3, faithfully reproducing the supplied actual in-game screenshot. Preserve this exact three-quarter aiming stance and orientation: head turned slightly toward image left, both articulated hands holding the same compact long weapon across the chest, the same crossed/overlapping forearms, one knee bent forward and the feet close together in the original pose. Match the dark metallic black/gray plates, small muted bronze worn edges, narrow faceplate with its paired red diagonal markings and small pale center, round shoulder joints, angular chest/waist plates, broad smooth upper-leg plates, round knee joints and dark tapered shin/foot shapes. Preserve the visible silhouette, limb proportions, weapon shape, wear pattern placement and every readable panel boundary from the reference. Do not substitute a LOKI mech, another Cerberus unit or a new armor design; do not add helmet fins, red lighting strips elsewhere, limbs, weapons or accessories. Keep hands and torso naturally occluded by the gun as in the source, without inventing a new view. Exactly one complete robot with head, weapon muzzle, back-mounted structure and both foot tips fully contained, at least 10 percent transparent margin on every side. Remove only the room, stairs, barrier, HUD, floor shadow and large purple lens flare. Use the source's readable muted metal palette without colored environmental glow bleeding into transparent space. Real alpha transparency; no ground, pedestal, ambient halo, colored background, text, border, sheet or collage. Preserve the restrained final-game model detail, not a redesign or photorealistic reimagining.

notes: Capture finale Omega entière inspectée : tête, arme et deux pieds complets.
Arme et avant-bras occultent le torse; lumière rose environnementale à distinguer des marquages rouges réels.
Type Rampart distinct de LOKI; aucune tenue ou variante d'un sujet refusé.
